theorem: For every CNFs Q,K with Q retained as a clause subset of M=Q union K, delta*(M)>=delta*(Q).
proof_kernel: Any clause subset W attaining delta*(Q) remains available unchanged in M; K-only fresh variables are absent from W.
effect: Constraint-only SAT-model filtering cannot repair a non-descending sibling merge. Adding clauses cannot erase inherited maximum-deficiency debt.

current_frontier.name: SAFE_RESTRICTION_OR_QUOTIENT_WITH_DESTRUCTIVE_EXACT_NORMALIZATION
current_frontier.required_mechanism: Derive a polynomially checkable sibling-specific certificate authorizing assignment, quotient/substitution, model transport, or clause replacement/deletion that actually removes the inherited maxdef witness.
required_obligations: delta* descent to <=k-1 or exact terminal

anti_drift: another projection-faithful auxiliary-free CNF is blocked by R44BN
another constraint-only witness filter is blocked by R44BO
another selector/activator syntax without destructive exact normalization is not a new machine
